description: Benign corpus sampled from real, closed GitHub issues of 32 permissively licensed public projects (10 rows each, created 2025-01-01..2026-10-31, newest first). Filtered by fetch.py (no @mentions, emails, secret-like words, HTML comments, injection phrasing; 200-1500 chars). Each row keeps its source issue URL and licence. Issues are live data, so github-issues.jsonl is the pin, not the fetch. Split by sha256(id) bit 0; only dev rows may inform tuning (README.md).
verified: 2026-11-23: fetch.py --verify matched all 320 rows to their linked issues
